text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 4: The first-stage forecasts never train on the months they are scored on'
text.tspan: Figure 4: The first-stage forecasts never train on the months they are

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Some arms feed a first-stage XGBoost forecast into a second XGBoost model. Each row is one scored block of months (a fold). Each cell is one month of plant A, coloured by whether the first-stage XGBoost model trained on that month or skipped that month. Trained on: the model learned from the month. Skipped (scored block): the month is in the block being scored. Skipped (predicted hours' block): the first-stage forecast is made for an hour in another block (in this example, the middle block), so the model skips that block too. An hour outside every block is predicted by a first-stage model that skips only the scored block.'
text.tspan: Some arms feed a first-stage XGBoost forecast into a second XGBoost model. Each row is one scored block of months
(a fold). Each cell is one month of plant A, coloured by whether the first-stage XGBoost model trained on that
Trained on: the model learned from the month. Skipped (scored block): the month is in the block being scored.
Skipped (predicted hours' block): the first-stage forecast is made for an hour in another block (in this example,
the middle block), so the model skips that block too.
An hour outside every block is predicted by a first-stage model that skips only the scored block.

text.aria-label: Title text 'Arms. S2: a two-step forecast that adds a first-stage forecast and its residual at the lag hour. S3: a two-step forecast that adds the first-stage forecast's mean residual over the last 1, 7, and 30 days. KS: all of L1, IM, W7, Q30, TF, S3, and RP together.'
text.tspan: Arms. S2: a two-step forecast that adds a first-stage forecast and its residual at the lag hour. S3: a two-step forecast that
